question: Which of the following Acts of 1947 regulates the Indian labour law with regard to trade unions as well as individual workmen?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Industrial Disputes Act**__**. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The **Indian Labour Law** is governed by the **Industrial Disputes Act, 1947** in as much as it relates to** trade unions **and specific workers employed in any industry on the Indian mainland.
 
• The Act also establishes:
 
 
• a clause that provides for the** worker to be compensated** in the event of a **shutdown, layoff, or retrenchment.**
 
• the process for obtaining** advance approval **from the relevant government to** lay off employees, retrench them or shut down** industrial facilities.
 
• the steps to be taken in response to** unfair labour practices** by an **employer, a trade union, or employees**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indian Councils Act:**

 
 
• The **Indian Councils Act of 1861** was an Act of the British Parliament that changed the way** India's executive council operated** such that it operated as a cabinet with a** portfolio structure**.
 
• **Six "ordinary members" **made up this cabinet, each in charge of a different division of the **Calcutta government: the home, revenue, military, law, finance, and (from 1874) public works.**
 
 
 
• **Charter Act:**
 
 
• The East India Company's** monopoly over India **was broken by the **Charter legislation of 1813.**
 
• Yet, the business was able to maintain its monopoly in** commerce with China **and** trade in tea with India.**
 
 
 
• **Rowlatt Act:**
 
 
• **The Imperial Legislative Council,** British India's legislature, passed the** Rowlatt Acts in February 1919**.
 
• The acts permitted the **incarceration of suspects without a trial **and allowed for the trial of some political crimes without juries.
